title: Name That Kick
blurb: No hands, three touches, a rattan ball. Learn the Malay names.
fact: In the 1950s sepak raga was played across Malay villages like Kampong Eunos and Geylang Serai. In HDB estates, residents added takraw markings to badminton courts.
credit: Facts from the National Heritage Board's Roots entry on sepak takraw. Text and art are original.
